thesis: The morning thesis did not break: ASO is still a relative-strength leader (rs_63 +0.57, above SMA20 63.97, SMA50 56.50 and SMA200 53.15), it is 2.1% below the 71.29 high, and no new news or SEC filing has come out against it. The trade setup did break, though. The stock gapped to 68.76 and ran to 69.77, so the morning zone of 66.2-67.6 was never touched (today's low was 68.13). It is also above the updated technical zone of 67.8-69.0, and reward/risk at the last price is only 1.33 (73.84 target, 66.7 stop), below the 1.5 floor. RSI is 69 and price is 9% above SMA20 in a risk-off regime, so this moves from Overweight to Hold. It becomes a pullback watch, to be re-rated if price comes back into 67.8-69.0, where reward/risk is 2.1 from the top of the zone.
invalidation: A daily close below 66.7 (under the Nov 12 swing low of 66.96), or a failed break of 71.29 followed by a close under 65.83 (Nov 6 low), ends the near-term uptrend; a close below SMA20 (63.97) ends the trend.
key_risks: Reward/risk at the 69.77 last price is 1.33 (4.07 up vs 3.07 down), below the 1.5 minimum; the morning zone of 66.2-67.6 was not filled
Stop of 66.7 is only about 0.9 ATR (2.3 vs ATR 2.55) below the top of the new zone, and today's range was 2.91, so a stop-out on normal noise is likely
